column1: # clues.tsv for ft_isascii -- pedagogic hints only: each line is a QUESTION, never the expected value or the fix.
# Format: <hint><TAB><CASE label><TAB>...   (a line fires if ANY of its cases fails)
man isascii speaks of a 7-bit value: which codes fit in 7 bits, and are 0 and 0x7f among them? What does p.8 say a classification function returns for a character in its class?
Which is the first code that needs an eighth bit? Does any code from there up to 0xff fit in 7 bits, and does your function check that end of the range?
Which value does <stdio.h> give EOF? Is a negative int a 7-bit value?
